description: A donation of publicly-traded securities (stock / ETF shares) to etzhayyim, via DTC/brokerage transfer (the standard non-profit appreciated-securities-gift mechanism). Per Charter Rider §2(b) (no speculative finance) + ADR-2605192115 (donation-only), donated securities are NEVER held as a speculative equity position — `heldAsEquityPosition` is a structural const false. The security is liquidated by the receiving brokerage promptly after transfer, and the USDC-equivalent proceeds enter the normal TitheRouter donation flow (`com.etzhayyim.give.usdc.donation`, cross-linked via `liquidationDonationRef`). This record is the durable, content-addressed attestation of the ORIGINAL gift-in-kind (for donor fair-market-value substantiation, e.g. IRS Form 8283-equivalent) — it is not itself a transferable or on-chain-custodied asset. See `90-docs/adr/2605192245-etzhayyim-global-land-sovereignty.md` for the structurally analogous land-donation attestation pattern this Lexicon mirrors.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

securityIdentifier.description: The security's identifier under `securityIdentifierScheme` (e.g. ticker "AAPL", or a CUSIP/ISIN string).

shareQuantity.description: Whole shares transferred. Fractional-share gifts are recorded as the nearest whole-share brokerage confirmation; the fractional remainder (if any) is noted in `brokerageTransferConfirmationCid`.

fairMarketValueUsdMicros.description: Fair market value of the gift at `valuationDateUtc`, in USD micros (×1e6), per ADR-2605190900 integer-with-implied-units. Standard non-profit FMV substantiation is the average of the high and low trading price on the date of transfer.

valuationDateUtc.description: The date used for `fairMarketValueUsdMicros` — normally the date the shares are transferred into the receiving brokerage account, not the date the donor initiated the transfer.

brokerageTransferConfirmationCid.description: IPFS CID of the brokerage's DTC transfer confirmation (or equivalent transfer-agent confirmation for non-DTC-eligible securities), encrypted per ADR-2605181100 if it carries donor account details.

heldAsEquityPosition.description: STRUCTURAL (Charter Rider §2(b) no speculative finance): always false. Donated securities are never retained as an equity position; they are liquidated promptly and the proceeds route through the ordinary USDC donation flow.

liquidatedAtUtc.description: When the brokerage completed the sale. Absent until liquidation completes (a donation record may exist briefly before its liquidation is confirmed — the gift itself, not its cash conversion, is what this record attests).

liquidationProceedsUsdMicros.description: Actual USDC-equivalent proceeds after brokerage fees (may differ from `fairMarketValueUsdMicros`, which is the donor's tax-substantiation value, not the net proceeds).

liquidationDonationRef.description: AT URI of the `com.etzhayyim.give.usdc.donation` record created once the brokerage wires/transfers the liquidation proceeds and they enter TitheRouter as USDC. Absent until liquidation completes.

donorNoteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the Council. Encrypted per ADR-2605181100.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation-record submission (the brokerage transfer may complete slightly before or after this record is authored).
